title: BuySmart Payment & Security FAQ
content: BuySmart supports UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit & Debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, RuPay), NetBanking, and Cash on Delivery (COD). All transactions are encrypted via 256-bit SSL encryption. We never store CVV or card PINs.

title: Price Match Guarantee Policy
content: BuySmart offers a 48-hour Price Match Guarantee on all laptops and smartphones. If you find the identical brand-new in-stock item sold at a lower price on authorized platforms within 48 hours of purchase, BuySmart refunds the difference in store credit.

title: Student Discount Program
content: Verified college students with a valid .edu or university ID card are eligible for an additional 7% instant discount on all Laptops and Audio products. Register via your student profile to claim.
